_comment: High-fidelity geometry gate. Per RN component: rn styles path + a list of {rnProp, sot} where 'sot' is a dot-path into src/core/design/tokens/geometry.json (array indices allowed, e.g. lists.listItem.padding.0). check-geometry.mjs resolves the expected value FROM geometry.json (single source of truth — no duplicated numbers here) and asserts the RN styles.ts declares `rnProp: <value>`. Add an entry when you port a component; check-geometry skips entries whose rn styles.ts doesn't exist yet. 'oneOf: true' means the RN value must be ONE of a SoT array (e.g. avatar sizes).
